title: Boruto 10th Anniversary Site Teases October Reveal and Special Movie
text:
Boruto's official 10th Anniversary site lists a mysterious October advertisement and a special movie, sparking speculation about the anime's future after Naruto NYCC teases.
The official Boruto 10th Anniversary website launched on the evening of Thursday, October 1, 2026 (October 2 in Japan), featuring a distorted transition from Naruto Next Generations to Two Blue Vortex. The site includes scrolling elements such as new paperback volume releases, the debut of Volume 9, and commentary from Shuji Okuda, a longtime Naruto fan of the comedy duo Gakuten Soku.
Critically, the site also contains conspicuous teases yet to be revealed, including a special movie and an advertisement marked for release sometime this October. These are the biggest current hints, with promises of more coming soon.
Boruto 10th Anniversary Site Details
The Boruto 10th Anniversary homepage hub was released on October 1, 2026, and serves as a central point for updates on the franchise. It showcases a tasteful set of scrolling elements, such as new paperback volume releases and the debut of Volume 9. Commentary from Shuji Okuda of the comedy duo Gakuten Soku is also featured.
However, the most intriguing aspects are the teases for a special movie and an advertisement slated for October. These placeholders suggest significant announcements are imminent, potentially related to the Boruto anime's future.
With Naruto Uzumaki's birthday being commemorated by a special NARUTO: What's Next? panel at New York Comic Con 2026 on October 10, fans are strongly advised to check the Boruto site for coinciding updates. The timing suggests a coordinated reveal.
Naruto Anime Future Teases at NYCC
At New York Comic Con, there have been thrilling glimpses teased with promises of something big and the global reveal of a brand-new Naruto anime explicitly laid out by the official Naruto website. This is arguably already plenty of hype, suggesting either a sequel Naruto project, the long-promised four episodes, or something more ambitious for longtime fans.
But this isn't the only recent tease from Masashi Kishimoto's shinobi world. The Boruto site's teases add to the anticipation, indicating that the franchise is expanding in multiple directions.
While new Naruto anime news is likely to get a more enthusiastic response overall, it's important to consider the multiple years of Boruto content yet to be brought to the screen. The special movie tease could simply be another PV-style release akin to recent Boruto manga trailers, but doubling down with a release window suggests greater significance or another reveal entirely.
What Boruto's Anime Feature Could Look Like
Given news already swirling about more Naruto anime, the approach the franchise appears to be taking resembles what was revealed earlier this year for Dragon Ball Super. That is, a newly-released, re-cut Dragon Ball Super: Beerus project tying in multiple subsequent arcs, intended as the definitive way to enjoy it, along with the reveal of Dragon Ball Super: Galactic Patrol that same day, pushing the anime toward adapting new arcs.
Boruto's anime, should it get a similar announcement at or near the Naruto NYCC event, will likely get such a reveal, with a poster being almost certainly the first glimpse for which fans can reasonably hope. As always, it's important to keep in mind that the Boruto part 2 anime is already confirmed.
Any such advertisement that's not merely another trailer using animated panels, if not an outright trailer, would mean the classic unveiling of the next Boruto anime's poster, ahead of any animated first looks. It's a good reminder that even a poster or key visual would be more substantial anime news than practically any past update for Boruto, and an indication that fans won't have to wait much longer.
Any further speculation is, for now, based on English interpretation of the special movie element, and how more Boruto anime would line up with any mainline Naruto projects. Fans are eagerly awaiting October for potential revelations.
